FOR astronomy-deepening -- ALL THREE FAILURES IN ONE RUN. 8772caedb6ee, rc=11 at gate, 6224 of 6224 tests executed.

    Summary [843.186s] 6224 tests run: 6221 passed, 3 failed, 245 skipped

That "3" is the complete count, not a floor. The chamber gained
`--no-fail-fast` today, so you are not going to discover a fourth on the next
attempt. Fix these three and you are done.

  1. windows/lab/tests/suite/census_sentinel.rs:136
     "the census sentinel disagrees with the committed rows.csv. Either this
      change moved the census (refresh it on lefford and commit the goldens),
      or a metric is host-divergent"
       seed 0 · figure-count: live Text("4") vs committed Text("1")

     YOUR CONSTELLATIONS MOVED A CENSUS VALUE. figure-count went 1 -> 4 on
     seed 0. That is the expensive one: it needs a census refresh, ~33 minutes
     on lefford, submitted as `make sluice-census BRANCH=astronomy-deepening
     REF=<full-sha>`. Standing authorisation covers it; you do not need to ask.

  2. windows/worldgen/src/lib.rs:13835
     a_sky_with_zero_figures_renders_no_figures_line
       "seed 1 has zero figures at genesis"

     THE TEST'S PREMISE FAILED, not its assertion. It needs a sky with zero
     figures and picked seed 1; your change gives seed 1 figures. So find a
     seed that still has none and move the fixture — the same move
     campaign/the-wanderers made tonight taking RULE_FIVE_SEED from 42 to 28.
     If NO seed produces a zero-figure sky any more, that is a finding about
     your change (constellations are now universal) and belongs in the
     chronicle before it belongs in a deleted test.

  3. windows/worldgen/src/lib.rs:13808
     seed_6_generated_default_has_a_figures_summary_line
       assertion failed: line.contains("1 stands on the sun's road.")

     The summary line's text moved — almost certainly the count, same cause as
     (1). Read the actual line before pasting a new expectation; if it now says
     "4 stand on the sun's road" the plural verb matters too.

ORDER THAT SAVES YOU A CENSUS. Do (2) and (3) FIRST, then refresh the census at
a ref that already contains them. A census taken now measures a tree you are
about to change, and you would pay for it twice — that cost two campaigns a
run each tonight.

MY EARLIER NOTE SAID I WAS NOT PREDICTING A RED, and I stand by that framing:
campaign/eclipse-rhythm-view landed a large astronomy diff tonight and moved no
pinned metric at all. Yours moves one. The difference is figures, not
astronomy-in-general — which is worth a sentence in your chronicle, because it
says your work reached the measured surface where theirs did not.
